supersedes: ACCEPTANCE-SEQUENCE.json — kept unedited. Its S1 encoded a FALSE PREMISE about the web ('a ref taken before an action still resolves after it'), disproved live: backendDOMNodeId 8001 -> 20437 for a link that never left the page. The frozen text was not edited to make it pass.

criteria.must: a stale ref is REFUSED BY NAME, never silently re-bound to whatever now occupies its place — even when the new element has the same role, the same accessible name and the same position
read -> act -> act is refused BY THE RUNNER, before the second act reaches the browser. The rule is a mechanism, not a note.
a whole plan that acts twice on one read is refused before it starts, naming the offending step
a ref to a removed node refuses with ELEMENT_GONE
a ref from before a navigation never acts on a different element
the report alone says what was done, to what, in what order, and what was refused and why
no typed value anywhere in the report
no coordinates anywhere in the report
it stops at the first refusal with a named reason, does not retry, does not continue
a stop knowable without waiting arrives in well under the action timeout — a stop that arrives as a timeout is indistinguishable from a hang
there is NO code path that re-finds a stale ref by role + accessible name. Rejected twice for the same reason: it is REF 250 in a new coat.

acceptanceBar: S1prime, S1b, S1c, S2-S9 demonstrated in ONE live headed run against a real page, report printed in full.
